label: SUPERVISED_EVAL
note: General, source-derived repairs only. NO target-specific hard-coding (no contest names / award titles / award text). Each signal is a structural source pattern that would catch a FAMILY of awards. This phase PROPOSES only; module edits are a separate explicitly-approved phase.

repairs.diagnosis: Awarded loci were surfaced as advisory candidates but their class was not routed into the triage handoff. Root cause: class signals are derived from locus NAME tokens only, so a surfaced function whose award-class is carried in its BODY (not its name) is mis-classed or out-competed within its class.
repairs.general_signal: Derive coverage class signals from the candidate's generated-mechanism BODY fields (source_backed_trigger, affected_state_assets_permissions, attacker_action) in addition to name tokens; widen coverage to KEEP more class reps when multiple plausible classes share a locus.
repairs.fp_risk: low (still advisory; only widens upstream representation)

repairs.diagnosis: Award locus is present in the coverage manifest but no advisory candidate surfaced it: the checkpoint-driven sweep (accounting + state-transition) plus top-N prioritizer did not reach it.
repairs.general_signal: Add recall sweep clauses for the under-covered structural primitives observed (authorization-modifier presence, external-call-before-state-write, signature/nonce checks) and raise the top-N / checkpoint-keyword breadth; these are source-derivable without award text.
repairs.fp_risk: medium (wider pool -> more advisory candidates; gate stays strict so no severe-FP impact)

repairs.diagnosis: Award locus is not enumerated in the coverage manifest at all (scope/enumeration gap): library/abstract/interface-inherited functions and externally-defined integration points fall outside the manifest's in-scope set.
repairs.general_signal: Extend the manifest builder to enumerate inherited/library/abstract functions reachable from in-scope contracts and integration entrypoints (oracle adapters, external hooks) as in-scope surface.

repairs.diagnosis: ORACLE_PRICING (0/4 surfaced) and EXTERNAL_INTEGRATION (1/2) are the weakest classes corpus-wide: their checkpoint/template coverage is thin, so few candidates and no class representation.
repairs.general_signal: Add oracle/pricing checkpoint markers (latestRoundData/getReserves/slot0/twap staleness) and external-integration markers (hook/bridge/adapter/wrap) to the recall templates and coverage class signals.

repairs.diagnosis: 57 awards reached MECHANISM_GENERATED but completion/runtime-PoC was not sampled (the expensive tail; this phase mapped upstream corpus-wide). This is an EXPECTED throughput limit, not a precision defect.
repairs.general_signal: Build reusable per-class PoC scaffolds (the P271 lending scaffold generalized to access/order/share/DoS) so the mechanism->exact bridge can be applied at higher throughput on the surfaced+routed set.
repairs.fp_risk: low (gate stays strict: exact mechanism + attacker path + delta + victim/gainer + runtime + FP refutation)

repairs.diagnosis: Two corpora (raw_answer_key 'captured_rows' schema) provide award title+severity but NO affected-contract/function, so locus-funnel mapping is impossible. These are count-only.
repairs.general_signal: Backfill affected-contract/function for title-only award keys (one-time eval-data enrichment) so they become locus-mappable; not a pipeline repair.
